Alex (Sales): Hey team — Nebula signed up for a 2-week POC. They want hosted API keys with 48h TTL, rotation every 48h, IP allowlist, and the ability to revoke mid-POC. Also they need audit logs delivered and a simple runbook for their devs. Can we scope out an ops runbook and automation?
Mira (Solutions): Thanks — quick clarifications: keys should be scoped to embeddings.read and completions.read only, rate limit ~100 RPS, tag keys with `team:nebula` and `poc:true`. Customer prefers automated rotation and webhook notifications when keys rotate/revoke.
Sam (DevEx): We can do ephemeral tokens via the console today for most customers. For enterprise POC we usually create scoped tokens via Sales Ops and store them in Vault. Automation wise: we have an internal endpoint to create scoped keys. Minimal curl example below to create a 48h scoped key:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $RW_ADMIN_TOKEN\" \n  -d '{"scope":"embeddings.read,completions.read","ttl":"48h","allowed_ips":["203.0.113.0/24"],"tags":{"team":"nebula","poc":"true"},"webhook_url":"https://hooks.salesops.internal/nebula"}'
```
Response returns `id`, `key`, `expires_at`. Rotation flow: create new key, update app config, then revoke old key via `/v1/keys/{id}/revoke`.
Lee (Eng): FYI Hosted tokens support TTLs down to minutes and up to 30d. 48h is fine. For rotation we'd recommend: 1) create new key, 2) warm prefix cache (if needed), 3) swap in app, 4) revoke old key. API endpoints: `POST /v1/keys` (create), `POST /v1/keys/{id}/revoke` (revoke), `POST /v1/keys/{id}/rotate` (if you want server-side rotation). For IP allowlist include `allowed_ips` in payload. Audit logs: event stream `keys.create`, `keys.revoke`, `keys.rotate` available in Console -> Audit -> Exports; we can also forward to their syslog via log-sink. For SSO customers, recommend a service-account mapping if they can't do full SAML for a short POC.
sec-bot: Security checklist (short): minimal privilege scope, TTL <= 48h, rotation every 48h, store tokens in customer Vault, enable KMS for any stored secrets, enable Console MFA for any human-driven ops, record requestor + reason in ticket, enable audit forwarding. If you suspect compromise: revoke immediately, block IP ranges, issue new keys, rotate secrets in app, and run a quick access-log review. See internal sec doc: https://intra.redwood/sec/poc-key-playbook (internal).
Mira (Solutions): Can Sales Ops automate issuance? I can run the script but want to handoff a one-click step. Sam — can you share a `rwi-ctl` example we can use in an onboarding ticket? Also want an escalation play if key leaks mid-week.
Sam (DevEx): Yep — `rwi-ctl` added for Sales Ops. Example: `rwi-ctl keys create --scope embeddings.read,completions.read --ttl 48h --ips 203.0.113.0/24 --tag team=nebula --tag poc=true --webhook https://hooks.salesops.internal/nebula` Output: `KEY=sk_live_... ID=key_abc123 EXPIRES=2026-04-05T12:00:00Z`. Rotation helper: `rwi-ctl keys rotate --id key_abc123 --webhook https://hooks.salesops.internal/nebula`. I'll push a tiny script to internal repo and attach to the ticket.
Alex (Sales): Timeline: Nebula wants everything by Friday EOD (they kick off devs Monday). Can we also attach a rotation webhook that pings both Nebula ops + our SalesOps channel?
Lee (Eng): Yes — keys support `webhook_url` metadata. We'll add logic to send events `created/rotated/revoked` with the key id and masked key. We'll also create a canary token tied to the key to detect misuse. Recommend pre-warming the model variant they'll use to avoid cold-start latency on first calls. If they want to test heavy qps, advise Dedicated pooling — but for a 2-week trial hosted is fine.
Mira (Solutions): Handoff plan I'll put in the ticket: Sales Ops runs `rwi-ctl create`, drops the key into their Vault entry for Nebula, confirms app can call, sets up webhook to their ops and to `#salesops-nebula`. Revocation play (documented): 1) `POST /v1/keys/{id}/revoke` 2) update allowlist to 0.0.0.0/32 to block 3) issue new key 4) rotate in app and confirm 5) notify customer + legal if needed.
Sam (DevEx): I'll upload scripts + runbook (30–45min) and schedule a 30-min handoff with Nebula and Sales Ops. Will include sample Terraform snippet for adding allowed IPs and example webhook consumer.
Alex (Sales): Great — please cc me on the ticket and drop the runbook link here when ready. Also flag any blockers (SAML gap, log-sink setup) so we can escalate. :rocket:
Mira (Solutions): On it. Creating Zendesk ticket now and assigning to @Sam and @Lee.
Sam (DevEx): Ping me when ticket created. I'll attach the script and run the first create in staging.
Lee (Eng): I'll make sure rotation webhook is ready and add a small Rate Limit guard for the POC keys (100rps).
sec-bot: Reminder — add `requested_by` and `business_justification` fields to key metadata for audit.
Alex (Sales): Thanks everyone. If we can have runbook + key issued by Friday we're golden.
Mira (Solutions): Will follow up with timeline in the ticket.
Sam (DevEx): Uploading now.
Alex (Sales): Thanks — tagging @sec-bot and @Lee. :white_check_mark:
